fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2025-03-17, the complainant reported being warned by a person near Palar Park Industrial Area in Madurai not to enter the disputed property. The time of the incident was given as 06:30 on 2025-03-13. Buvaneswari Kannan approached Madurai South PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000331. A car bearing the number TN-39-ZZ-1044 was seen leaving the area. A witness, Padmini Raj, reachable on 9000000032, was mentioned in the complaint. The complaint mentions Gokul Sundaram, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000491, in connection with the events. The complainant mentioned a call detail reference and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect reportedly warned the victim at the disputed property.
fields.Keywords: threat, property dispute, industrial area, early morning, car, photograph, witness, suspect
